content:
设 \(a=\frac{\pi}{4}-x\)，则 \(\sin a=\frac{3}{5}\)。

\[
\sin 2x=\sin\left(2\left(\frac{\pi}{4}-a\right)\right)
=\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-2a\right)
=\cos 2a
\]

\[
\cos 2a=1-2\sin^2 a=1-2\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)^2
=1-\frac{18}{25}
=\frac{7}{25}
\]

答案：D
